Legacy NIK replay-generator registry reference

These two files retain the exact registry output used by the existing replay
generation qualification before public registry generation moved to the native
nik-authority-catalog-v1 projector. They are data fixtures, not public runtime
sources and not authorities for native registry formatting.

tools/test_nik_authority_generation_v1.py still checks all three legacy outputs
byte-for-byte, plus its support checks and source mutations. Its header/source
arguments now identify these fixtures; its semantic argument remains the replay
artifact. The native registry has a separate complete-field/identity/consumer
gate. Neither comparison is silently skipped.

The retained files were copied exactly from the prior checked-in generated
registry, without invoking the Python generator. Updating this legacy baseline
requires reviewing the corresponding replay-generator/catalog change.
